workload.source: adapted from the hyperfine command in the description of https://github.com/sharkdp/fd/pull/1422 (fd -u '^$' on a corpus), run on one thread over a fixed generated tree of 200,000 files (eval/tasks/workloads/rust/make_tree.py) instead of the Linux, Rust and Chromium corpora

evidence.note: description, read by hand: hyperfine tables of a complete traversal (`fd -u '^$'`) of three corpora, fd before and after the change
